title: Bousfield Reachability on Generalized Pentagons
content: Martínez Alberga and Roitzheim ([5], Theorem 5.4) proved that every model structure on the fivepoint pentagon can be obtained from the trivial model by left and right Bousfield localizations. We extend this result to generalized pentagons with an arbitrarily long second branch. Non-universal models are constructed by extending model structures along full inclusions of chain categories. For universal models, a functor to the category 0 → 1, or its dual, identifies a predecessor with one acyclic class unchanged. A factorization argument describes its weak equivalences as the arrows sent to identities. The resulting construction proves reachability for the whole family. The proof establishes existence of a finite localization sequence, without an optimal bound on its length.
